description: Regex scan for the degenerate ANO5 N-terminal motif across orthologs, plus a figure of conservation, BH benchmarking and ortholog BH distribution
code:
import json, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
P="prov"
orth=json.load(open(f"{P}/ANO5_orthologs_trembl.json"))
# degenerate consensus derived from the human/mouse/chicken/platypus/caecilian windows
PAT=re.compile(r"[KRQ][A-Z]{0,3}[YF][NSTH]LFL[KQRH][A-Z]?RL")
rows=[]
for sp,sq in orth.items():
    nt=sq[:200]
    m=PAT.search(nt)
    rows.append(dict(species=sp, present=bool(m), pos=(m.start()+1 if m else None),
                     hit=(m.group(0) if m else "")))
mt=pd.DataFrame(rows); mt.to_csv(f"{P}/ANO5_motif_presence_orthologs.csv", index=False)
print("species scanned: %d ; motif present in %d (%.1f%%)"%(len(mt), mt.present.sum(), 100*mt.present.mean()))
print("\npresent, 12 examples:"); print(mt[mt.present].head(12)[["species","pos","hit"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\nabsent, 12 examples:"); print(mt[~mt.present].head(12)["species"].to_string(index=False))

# ---------------- figure: real results only ----------------
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
cons=pd.read_csv(f"{P}/ANO5_ortholog_region_conservation.csv")
bhtab=pd.read_csv(f"{P}/ANO5_BH_motif_comparison.csv")
bt=pd.read_csv(f"{P}/ANO5_ortholog_Nterm_BH.csv")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3, figsize=(15.5,4.6))

order=["N-tail control 20-36","motif 48-64","Ca2+ site 622-638","SCRD 530-546","N-tail control 70-86"]
d=[cons[cons.region==o].pct_identity.values for o in order]
bp=ax[0].boxplot(d, labels=[o.replace(" ","\n") for o in order], patch_artist=True, showfliers=False)
for b,c in zip(bp["boxes"],["#bbbbbb","#d95f02","#7570b3","#1b9e77","#bbbbbb"]): b.set_facecolor(c)
ax[0].set_ylabel("best-match identity to human (%)")
ax[0].set_title("Cross-species conservation, 189 vertebrate ANO5 orthologs")
ax[0].tick_params(axis="x", labelsize=7.5)

bb=bhtab.sort_values("BH_score")
bb=bb[bb.name!="ANO5 scrambled control"]
cols=["#d95f02" if "ANO5" in n else "#666666" for n in bb.name]
ax[1].barh(range(len(bb)), bb.BH_score, color=cols)
ax[1].set_yticks(range(len(bb))); ax[1].set_yticklabels([n.split(" (")[0] for n in bb.name], fontsize=7.5)
ax[1].set_xlabel("basic-hydrophobic score  (n_basic x n_hydrophobic / len) - n_acidic")
ax[1].set_title("ANO5 48-64 vs characterised anionic-lipid-binding motifs")

ax[2].hist(bt.maxBH_Nterm, bins=26, color="#7fb3d5", edgecolor="k", linewidth=.4)
ax[2].axvline(2.47, color="#d95f02", lw=2)
ax[2].text(2.42, ax[2].get_ylim()[1]*0.9, "human\n48-64", color="#d95f02", ha="right", fontsize=8)
ax[2].set_xlabel("max basic-hydrophobic score in residues 1-160")
ax[2].set_ylabel("ortholog species")
ax[2].set_title("N-terminal BH character across 190 ANO5 orthologs")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
